Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:

By the early 2030s, whole-brain consciousness copying is far beyond reach, making this prediction very unlikely By

Electric cars are likely to spread widely, yet planes and ships will complicate full transport electrification, so this prediction is moderately likely Electric
Climate change is already causing some irreversible impacts, so this prediction is likely in part but not universally irreversible Climate
Physical money is likely to decline, yet cash will probably survive in many societies, so this prediction is long-term moderately likely Physical
Scientists may unlock aging secrets, but living for centuries or forever remains highly speculative, so this prediction is unlikely Scientists
